# Scientific.Net

> > Scientific.Net is a peer-reviewed academic publishing platform specializing in materials science, engineering research, and scientific journals with institutional access and open access options.

Scientific.Net, operated by Trans Tech Publications Ltd., publishes high-quality peer-reviewed journals and book series across engineering and materials science disciplines. The platform serves researchers, institutions, and libraries worldwide with both traditional and open access publishing models.

## Getting Started

- [Home](https://www.scientific.net): Scientific.Net homepage: peer-reviewed academic journals and book series in materials science and engineering
- [About Us](https://www.scientific.net/Home/AboutUs): Company information about Trans Tech Publications Ltd. and Scientific.Net history
- [Contact Us](https://www.scientific.net/Home/Contacts): Contact information and support details for Scientific.Net in Switzerland

## For Authors & Publishers

- [Paper Submission](https://www.scientific.net/ForPublication/Paper): Paper submission guidelines and author instructions for publishing with Scientific.Net
- [Conference Publication](https://www.scientific.net/ForPublication/Conference): Conference proceedings publication guidelines and submission information
- [Downloads & Resources](https://www.scientific.net/DocuCenter): Document center with templates, catalogs, and resources for authors and editors

## For Libraries & Institutions

- [For Libraries](https://www.scientific.net/ForLibraries): Library subscriptions and institutional access to Scientific.Net journals and book collections
- [Open Access Partners](https://www.scientific.net/open-access-partners): Open access publishing partners and collaborative relationships with Scientific.Net
- [Read-and-Publish Agreements](https://www.scientific.net/read-and-publish-agreements): Read-and-publish agreements and open access partnership information

## Featured Journals

- [Advanced Materials Research](https://www.scientific.net/AMR/Details): Advanced Materials Research journal covering materials science and engineering research
- [Applied Mechanics and Materials](https://www.scientific.net/AMM/Details): Applied Mechanics and Materials journal details, scope, and publication policies
- [Advanced Engineering Forum](https://www.scientific.net/AEF/Details): Advanced Engineering Forum journal details, policies, and publication guidelines
- [Engineering Chemistry](https://www.scientific.net/EC/Details): Engineering Chemistry open access journal details and publication information
- [Engineering Innovations](https://www.scientific.net/EI/Details): Engineering Innovations journal details covering modern engineering developments

## Specialized Research Journals

- [Journal of Biomimetics, Biomaterials and Biomedical Engineering](https://www.scientific.net/JBBBE/Details): Biomimetics, Biomaterials and Biomedical Engineering journal details and scope
- [International Journal of Engineering Research in Africa](https://www.scientific.net/JERA/Details): International Journal of Engineering Research in Africa journal details and scope
- [Defect and Diffusion Forum](https://www.scientific.net/DDF/Details): Defect and Diffusion Forum journal details on mass diffusion and heat transfer
- [Diffusion Foundations and Materials Applications](https://www.scientific.net/DFMA/Details): Diffusion Foundations and Materials Applications journal covering mass and heat transport
- [Journal of Metastable and Nanocrystalline Materials](https://www.scientific.net/JMNM/Details): Journal of Metastable and Nanocrystalline Materials covering nanostructured materials research
